title: Parallel AI Agent Collaboration as Graph-Structured Distributed Block Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.30074v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parallel AI agents can produce useful local edits yet degrade a shared solution when their edits are combined. We model this coordination problem as discrete block optimization with an exactly evaluable objective and a known dependency graph. Independent sets certify compatible edits whose verified gains, measured against the same current solution, add exactly. A coordinator constructs a safe compatible candidate and can also evaluate interacting edits to capture favorable interactions. We prove that an optimal fractional coloring yields a merger that preserves a $1/\chi_f(G)$ fraction of the total verified local improvement, where $\chi_f(G)$ is the graph's fractional chromatic number. This guarantee is tight among mergers that select a subset of the same proposals. translated_title: 并行AI智能体协作作为图结构化的分布式分块优化
translated_abstract: 并行AI智能体可以产生有用的局部编辑，但当它们的编辑被组合在一起时，可能会使共享的解决方案变差。我们将这一协调问题建模为具有可精确求值目标函数和已知依赖图的离散分块优化问题。独立集可证明编辑之间的兼容性，这些经过验证的收益（相对于同一个当前解决方案测量）可以精确相加。协调者构建一个安全的兼容候选方案，同时也可以评估相互作用的编辑以捕获有利的交互效应。我们证明，最优分数染色所产生的合并方案能够保留已验证局部改进总量的 1/χ_f(G) 比例，其中 χ_f(G) 是图的分数色数。该保证在仅从相同提案集中选取子集的合并方案中是紧的。在条件性局部改进保证和分块误差界条件下，重复协作在目标差距上呈几何级数收敛。该速率区分了……
tldr: 本文将并行AI智能体的协作编辑问题建模为图结构化的离散分块优化，证明基于最优分数染色的合并方案能保留至少 1/χ_f(G) 比例的已验证局部改进，并使重复协作在目标差距上几何收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper models parallel AI agent collaboration as graph-structured discrete block optimization, proving that a merger based on optimal fractional coloring preserves at least a 1/χ_f(G) fraction of verified local improvements, with repeated collaboration converging geometrically in the objective gap.
